items.name: Inception Mercury 3
items.summary: Inception's flagship diffusion LLM claims to outperform GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on benchmarks while generating 1,068 tokens per second — evidence that text-diffusion architectures can scale to frontier quality with a 1M-token context window.

items.name: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: DeepSeek's updated checkpoint sharpens V4.1-Flash for agentic coding and tool use via reinforcement learning with self-feedback, with MIT-licensed open weights on Hugging Face and a 1M-token context window.

items.name: Cloudflare Clairic
items.summary: Cloudflare's first "System One" extraction model, in preview on Workers AI, pulls typed values out of unstructured inputs instead of generating text — billed input-only at $0.10 per million tokens, with an open-weights release planned later.

items.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
items.summary: MiniMax's low-cost agent model runs at $0.15/$0.60 per million input/output tokens with a 1M-token context, claiming ~70% lower agent-task cost and ~3x faster inference than M3 — open weights promised for October 23.

items.name: Reflection Beam (open weights)
items.summary: Reflection released Beam's weights, adding a 23B-active-parameter agent system to the open-weights stack — though the smallest official NVFP4 package is 294 GB and needs ~353 GB of GPU memory, making it a datacenter-class deployment.
